candidates.description: This vector represents characters and subword fragments from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector is related to Hindi script characters and morphemes.
This vector is related to punctuation marks, specifically commas, frequently attached to Hindi vowel matras.
These tokens represent fragmented sub-word text segments from the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and morphemes involving the action of doing.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel sign and consonant-vowel combinations used in Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common initial syllables and root prefixes in Hindi words written in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents sub-word tokens and vocabulary related to the Hindi language.
This feature vector detects Devanagari script characters, non-English text fragments, and specific punctuation symbols.
This vector activates on low-value integer numbers, particularly in the range of single digits to low hundreds.
